key_decisions: No dedicated cache layer (Redis / CDN); HTTP cache + postgres.js prepared-statement cache + typed-state-container + Intl format cache is sufficient
Vite SPA with manualChunks vendor split, route-level code split, Noto Sans Bengali woff2 subset preloaded
Audit-log INSERT is a single-statement INSERT (no transaction) with prepared statement; fire-and-forget stdout JSON line
L(bn, en) is a closure returning from a frozen Record<Locale, Record<Key, string>>; Intl.NumberFormat / Intl.DateTimeFormat cached per-locale
Three-layer-gate dispatch is O(1) per route: Map<RoutePath, Route> + Set<Capability> membership + pure business-rule function
argon2id (m=64MB, t=3, p=1) for password hashing
sha256(raw_token) for invitation tokens (high-entropy, no need for slow hash)
Cookie-based session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, 30-day) over JWT (single-tenant + free-tier envelope)
Three-layer gate (auth → capability → business-rule) is the binding dispatch; absence-asserted per route (R1.2)
No CSRF token (SameSite=Lax + no GET-with-side-effects closes the surface); no application-level encryption (vendor's TLS + at-rest is sufficient)
No per-Unit scalability targets (Q8=A); scalability is at the deployment level, not the per-Unit level
Single-tenant topology + free-tier envelope make a per-Unit scalability NFR redundant
Only audit_log is partitioned (by year, 5-year retention); all other tables are too small to benefit
No auto-scaling rules (free-tier envelope is the design point, not a stepping stone)
Deployment is the recovery unit for single-tenant topology
No circuit breaker / no retry policy (in-process typed function-calls; failure mode is typed Result/throw, not network retry)
Only DB transaction on state-mutating actions is appendAudit + the typed entity write (NFR5.1 immutability binding)
Idempotent migration (R1.1); vendor's daily snapshot is the RPO; staging auto-deploy on merge to main is the RTO
Email gateway graceful-degradation: 'copy this URL' UI when the gateway is down
Audit-log row IS the log line (no separate console.log for state-mutating actions)
stdout (JSON line) for non-state-mutating events: bootstrap, sign-in, sign-out, recovery, invitation, three-layer-gate denial, email-gateway graceful-degradation
No metrics collection pipeline (Prometheus / StatsD); vendor's free-tier slow-query dashboard covers the audit-log SLI set
No distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry / Jaeger); actor_id + business_id + route + ts in stdout is the per-action timeline
correlation_id (random(16)) propagated through every typed function-call in a single request; stored in audit_log.correlation_id
5 logical components: L1 (Identity), L2 (Audit), L3 (i18n), L4 (Router), L5 (State container)
Module boundaries (compile-time) + DB tables (runtime) + DB role (runtime, R1.1) are the isolation layers
No network between components; modular monolith; only network surfaces are browser ↔ runtime ↔ DB (vendor-managed)
Deploy-wide failure modes: L1 (Identity) + L4 (Router) are the entry points; L2 (Audit) is state-mutating-only; L3 (i18n) + L5 (State container) are degrade-gracefully
U1 owns the runtime services; U2-U5 own the business logic that consumes them via typed function-calls (contracts #1-4 + #9)
